messages:
lucy: Planning a short config-only rollout tonight at 02:00 UTC. Goal: reduce small-request tail by nudging routing + lower batch latency for medium prompts. No model changes.

lucy: Proposed deltas (serving params only)
```yaml
routing.shard_strategy: percent-shard
routing.shard_weights.small: 0.10 -> 0.18
batching.max_concurrency_per_gpu: 48 -> 36
batching.max_batch_size: 80 -> 88
batching.batch_timeout_ms: 600 -> 420
kvcache.default_ttl_sec: 7200 -> 5400
```

lucy: Rollout plan: canary 3% for 20m -> evaluate p95, 5xx, kv_evictions, tenant tail; ramp to 15% for 40m -> if stable, schedule 50% for 1h next change window.

miguel: ack. I'll add a lightweight dashboard and a synthetic probe for the small prompt shape so batching impact is visible.

sophie: Please exclude perf-load and e2e-test tenants again. They bias the batching distribution.

lucy: Good call. Adding tenant_exclude: ["perf-load", "e2e-test"]. Also enabling telemetry tag: rollout_id=1779991234.

ben: Auto-rollback triggers suggestion: rollback if 5xx rises by >=0.5% absolute for 3 consecutive 1m buckets OR p95 regresses by >150ms for 5m. Also immediate rollback if kv_evictions increase >25%.

lucy: Adding those hooks to the deploy config. We'll keep autotuner off for the rollout window so kernel selection is deterministic.

deploy-bot: @channel Deploy queued: config-only canary (id: 1779991234) by lucy -> service: inference-prod. Canary traffic: 3%. See /deploys/1779991234

deploy-bot: Step: applying canary at 02:00:05 UTC -> 3% traffic.

tara: oncall here. Watching kv_evictions, kv_miss_rate, and p95. I'll signal on any sudden change. :triangular_flag_on_post:

miguel: dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/rollouts/1779991234 (small-probe, p95, 5xx, kv_evictions). Refresh 30s.

lucy: quick note: enterprise-api tenant pinned to legacy config for 90m per pre-req.

sophie: thanks. Also add rollout note that this is to test shard redistribution behavior under medium load.

deploy-bot: Canary health @ +7m: p95 42ms (baseline 40ms), 5xx 0.04%, kv_evictions +3%. No rollback triggered.

ben: small drift but within thresholds. I recommend we hold for full 20m before ramp.

miguel: synthetic probe shows improved completion time for small prompts (~-8% median). Good sign.

lucy: ramping to 15% at +20m per plan. Watchlist: p95, kv_evictions, per-tenant tail.

deploy-bot: Ramp step executed at 02:20:12 UTC -> 15% traffic.

tara: seeing kv_evictions climbing slowly; at +25m it's +12%. Still under the 25% immediate-rollback threshold.

sophie: enterprise-api pinned ok, other tenants normal. Can we ensure alert ops-signal is set to paging if evictions >20%?

lucy: done. Paging threshold 20% evictions.

ben: adding a release note bullet: "Config-only: increased small-shard weight to favor tiny prompt paths; lowered batch timeout to reduce P95 on medium requests; tuned kvcache TTL downward to free memory under higher batching churn."

lucy: adding instruction for ops: rollback command is `/deploybot rollback 1779991234` (reverts serving params and shard weights). Keep in #eng-releases pinned.

deploy-bot: Health check @ +45m: p95 44ms (within acceptable), 5xx 0.05%, kv_evictions +14%, kv_miss_rate steady. No auto-rollback.

miguel: request: hold at 15% for 2 hours instead of immediate 50% ramp given eviction trend. I'll keep probes running.

tara: agree. If evictions hit 16% I'll open an incident; 20% -> automatic page + rollback recommendation.

lucy: agree to hold. Scheduling follow-up at +2h to decide next step.

ben: final note for release doc: include ops playbook steps to revert tenants pinned, and to re-enable autotuner after 4h if stable.

lucy: locking thread for now. We'll reconvene if thresholds or customer feedback arrives. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
